metadata.rules_text:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >85), model tends to overshoot and fail to correct; reduce forecast peak by 5–10% and apply mean reversion toward 30-day moving average.
- When sentiment history is flat (all 0.00), model exhibits high volatility and overconfidence; dampen forecast variance and anchor to recent 7-day average.
- In absence of official events, model overreacts to minor price fluctuations; use sentiment + event context to suppress false momentum signals.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in price correction; adjust for delayed mean reversion by adding 1–2 days of smoothing to true outcome lagged series.
